After confirming the feasibility of the proposed RSGD through simulations and prototype fabrication, its performance was evaluated using a 27-inch OLED panel. The electrical and optical characteristics, including luminance uniformity, were measured at room temperature using an Agilent DSO-9104 A oscilloscope and Konica Minolta CA-410 color analyzer. The luminance uniformity was evaluated at 27 positions arranged in a 3 × 9 grid across the panel, with white luminance measured at 600 cd/m 2 31 .
